title: Copy Dynamics GP Data to Azure Data Lake Storage

facts.text: Does not replace SQL Server backups used for migration or recovery.
Have Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 account with access to name and account key.
Cloud migration setup enabled for Dynamics GP.
Have SUPER permission set to use Azure Data Lake action on Cloud Migration Management.
Database folder in Azure Data Lake always set to gp-database; can rename after migration completes.
Second run requires deleting existing gp-database folder and contents first to copy data again.
